3959.title: Disabled subagents omitted from SDK exclusion list
3959.rootCauseOneLine: The disabled setting is enforced by a runtime hook but never adds native subagents to the SDK exclusion list.
3959.proposedFix: Derive SDK exclusions from the setting and cover live-session changes while retaining runtime denial.
3959.caveats: SDK-boundary test only; live tool descriptions, agent list, and token overhead were not measured. No automatic PR because the change affects tool-permission behavior.
